items.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
items.description: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give "talks some space", raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict.

items.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
items.description: Police say Abdul Ballout was shot and killed after he rushed at officers with a knife in a western borough of Berlin.

items.title: Three dead and several injured in shooting at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle
items.description: Police say two suspects were shooting at each other and one of them is in custody and one at large.

items.title: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' after arrest threat
items.description: Mamdani walked back his threat last week, acknowledging he lacked the legal power to arrest Netanyahu on a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court.

items.title: UK PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
items.description: The Ukrainian president will be Andy Burnham's first international visitor since taking office.

items.title: Millions see leaked copy of The Odyssey movie on X
items.description: Film studio Universal takes down a high-quality bootleg version of the film, which appeared on X.

items.title: Infantino tells Fifa critics to 'meditate, pray or watch football'
items.description: Fifa president Gianni Infantino tells critics to "meditate, pray or watch a football match" instead of "spreading hate and false rumours" about him and the World Cup.

items.title: Argentine leader calls Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'
items.description: Javier Milei spoke at a campaign rally for right-wing presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running against Lula.

items.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
items.description: The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tal, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.

items.title: Rapper Yung Filly tells trial 'vibes were good' with woman who accuses him of rape
items.description: The rapper takes the witness stand at his trial in Australia where he denies raping a fan in a hotel room.

items.title: Australian court upholds racial discrimination ruling against Pauline Hanson
items.description: One Nation leader loses bid to overturn ruling that she racially discriminated against Senator Mehreen Faruqi.

items.title: Shein swings to $99m loss as Trump tariffs hit sales
items.description: The announcement comes as the fast fashion giant prepares for its stock market debut in Hong Kong.
